notes.title: Mysterious SCP-682 bug fixed!
notes.content:
For everyone out there who's been struggling with the SCP-682 arc being blocked here:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41177852/e938507815d68ba0ab6acac73e02fceade8c64cb.png[/img]

[h1]Rejoice![/h1]
[h2]The solution to this nasty bug has been found at last![/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41177852/44350a3188e7565af8185f607c206ac9a86b81ed.png[/img]

Apparently I was trying to move SCP-682 toward the window over the span of a split-second, but during that split-second I was also trying to scale her. Because of this a small fraction of players were having their dialogue crash.

[h1]HOWEVER![/h1]
I've had the fix confirmed by players in our Discord that they can now complete the SCP-682 route! 

[h2]Thank you all so, so much for your patience.[/h2]
-Rebecca

notes.title: Doki Doki Anomaly Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Major Fix:[/h1]
-Saving from Decisions will no longer result in corrupted saves.
-Loading into Decisions will now actually load.
[h3]^If you were having difficulty with these please start a new game to reset your dialogue state.[/h3]

[h2]Minor Fixes[/h2]
-Several typos (If you find any please send them to the support email ːsteamthumbsupː )

Thank you to everyone for their patience! Hopefully this fixes the trouble you've been having! If you continue having difficulties please don't hesitate to let me know.

-Rebecca
Flightyfelon Games
